items.item_text: American Heart Association Basic Life Support (AHA BLS)
Minimum two-year degree or equivalent in physiology, anatomy, physics, mathematics, and electronics required
Must have a minimum of one year of experience performing all cardiac and/or vascular procedures and Cardiac Cath Lab monitoring.
In lieu of the minimum one year experience performing cardiac echo testing, we will accept a school rotation in the cardiology department at NHMC

Performs all non invasive studies to include Electrocardiograms, Signal Average ECG, Holter Monitors, Cardiovascular Stress Tests, Pacemaker Analysis, Vascular and/or Echocardiographic Ultrasound, as well as the ability to perform Cardiac Cath pressure monitoring. Follows established procedure in the performance of all studies and observes safety
precautions in the use and application of equipment. Observes and records thorough and accurate tests.

Carries out responsibilities appropriate to the established test and clerical procedures. Complies with procedures for the identification of tests, maintenance of cardiac files and patient's charts. Participates in clerical and reception activities.

Complies with procedure for the maintenance of supplies and equipment and carries out duties necessary to comply with related needs. Maintenance of a safe and orderly work area, which includes responsibilities for assisting with cleanup duties and equipment storage in appropriate areas. Maintains a surveillance of environmental conditions within the Cardiology Department. Follows established safety, emergency and infections control policies and procedures.
Displays appropriate attitude and behavior. Demonstrates an understanding of Dignity Health and NHMC's philosophy and shared values and incorporates them into daily performance.

Complies with ethical and legal responsibilities and restrictions; established lines of authority, supervision and communication. Demonstrates care, concern and courtesy when providing patient care services; while maintaining patient dignity. C. Performs those job duties assigned by the Director/Supervisor
Graduate from an accredited school of Cardiopulmonary Technology.
Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer, upon hire or
Fire Safety, within 90 Days of start date.
